description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hiththatiya East, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820004
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, nature of title, and any encumbrances or mortgages. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for specific plots of land in the Matara district.
